title: FruitsOfSpirit.lean: Emergence and Collapse of the Nine Fruits

canonical_node.axiom: The nine fruits of the Spirit are emergent properties of total coherence (chi = 1) and collapse if any law is zero.
definitions: chi-system: a system with ten laws, each represented by a value in a semiring, with chi as the product of all ten.
Coherence state s: a tuple of ten law values.
chi s: the product of all ten law values in state s.
Emerges f s: fruit f emerges from state s iff chi s = one.
Nine fruits: Love, Joy, Peace, Patience, Kindness, Goodness, Faithfulness, Gentleness, Self-Control.
derivation: Define Emerges f s := chi s = one.
By zero-collapse theorem, chi s = zero.
Since zero  one, chi s = one is false.
The proof of the emergence direction (chi s = one -> Emerges f s) is not fully formalized; it relies on the broader proof suite.
canonical_node.action: Treat the nine fruits as indicators of system coherence, not as inputs to be optimized. When fruits are absent, diagnose which law has collapsed to zero.
boundary: Does not prove that chi = 1 is sufficient for fruit emergence in all contexts; that is deferred to the broader proof suite.
Does not provide a method to increase fruit production directly.
Does not map specific fruits to specific laws; only to total coherence.
test: Check that the Lean file compiles without errors (except for the acknowledged sorry).
Verify that the theorem fruit_collapse is proven for all nine fruits.
Verify that the Emerges definition is used consistently.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Formalizes the relationship between the nine fruits and total coherence, proving the collapse direction and stating the emergence direction.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the existing coherence algebra results and the definition of chi as a product.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If removed, the formal link between the nine fruits and the coherence state is lost; the collapse theorem would no longer be available.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Quarantine until the sorry is resolved and the emergence direction is formally proven.

overstatement_risks: Claims 'airtight' logical chain despite a sorry.
Maps the Strong Force to Law 4 without formal justification.
Suggests practical implications beyond the formal scope.
kill_conditions: If the zero-collapse theorem is not actually proven in CoherenceAlgebra.
If the sorry cannot be resolved.
If the emergence direction is not proven and the claim of equivalence is retracted.
risk.lean_target: Resolve the sorry in fruit_collapse and provide a formal proof of the emergence direction (chi s = one -> Emerges f s) or explicitly mark it as an axiom.

plain_summary: This document describes a Lean4 file that attempts to prove that the nine fruits of the Spirit emerge only when the chi-system is fully coherent (chi = 1) and collapse if any law is zero. The collapse direction is claimed to be proven, but with a sorry, and the emergence direction is not fully formalized. The document also draws an analogy to the Strong Force, but this is not formally justified. The file is partially admissible but needs further work to be considered a complete formal proof.
